Item: Should the storage compartment be watertight?
Prompt / specification: A sealed box can still receive condensation and small leaks, then hold water against stored items and joints. Options: Shed bulk water while providing drainage and cross-ventilation | Use removable weather-resistant bins inside a ventilated bench | Caulk every joint into an airtight plywood chest

Item: How will the lid behave in wind?
Prompt / specification: An open outdoor lid can act as a sail, while a loose closed lid can lift or slam. Options: Use corrosion-compatible positive open and closed restraints | Use a removable lightweight panel stored indoors | Rely on lid weight

Item: Can the bench attach to the building?
Prompt / specification: Railings, waterproof membranes, facades, and shared structures may prohibit drilling or added wind loads. Options: Follow written property requirements and use an approved method | Keep the bench freestanding within a tested low stable footprint | Drill into railing, facade, or deck membrane without approval
